issue_title: The Five Days That Shook a City!
description:
The Innocent Forger!

A young woman gets ensnared in a life of crime, which soon brings her to the attention of Mr. District Attorney.

The Five Days That Shook a City!

The notorious Velvet Mask Gang goes on a crime rampage through the city.

Oddities in Crime

A short fact feature.

Studio Cop

A police officer responsible for protecting a major Hollywood studio recounts the story of a daring jewel heist.

The Million Dollar Racket!

Mr. District Attorney attempts to prosecute a gang of criminals running a protection racket in the city, but his case is complicated by frightened victims.

The Case of the Jealous Suitor

A jealous man kills the rival for his affections and stages it as a suicide.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Spook Crooks!

Mr. District Attorney works to crack down on alleged psychics and related charlatans who prey on average people.

The D.A. Takes a Vacation!

After Mr District Attorney receives a bullet wound from a desperate fugitive, he is directed to take a vacation to recover. Against his will, he is booked on a trip to South America, but soon finds that one of his fellow passengers is a notorious criminal.

The Statue of Liberty Racket!

Under the Green Flag

Wrestling Cop

The Crime File

A text story.

Dragnet!

Escaped criminal Big Mike Murdoch attempts to evade the long arm of the law. However, a massive manhunt is soon mounted that begins to pose a serious threat to his continued liberty.

issue_title: The Game That Has No Winners
description:
The Game That Has No Winners!

A crooked carnival, whose games are all rigged, rolls into town, soon bringing it and its criminal ways to the attention of Mr District Attorney.

Barber of the Big House

A barber is sent to prison for stealing from his clients, and sets up a salon on the inside to cater to his fellow prisoners.

The Man Who Laughed at Bullets!

A murderer goes on the run, taking his new bulletproof car with him. Finding himself to be invincible, he takes ever greater risks.

The Case of the Disappearing Passenger!

A wealthy man is murdered by his jealous servants, who force him to write a cheque for them before staging his disappearance.

The Crime File

A text story.

Second Chance Farm!

A group of ex-cons, eager to escape their pasts, work on Second Chance Farm and get a chance to turn their lives around.

Fake Accident Racket!

An insurance fraudster arrives in town, and uses all his tricks to defraud honest citizens with a series of cons.

I Defended the Monkey Man!

A criminal known as the Monkey Man, who is noticeably agile and daring, is arrested. Believing that he has suffered due to his troubled upbringing, Mr District Attorney takes an unusual approach to the man's trial.

Parole Cop

A parole officer discusses his typical work, and shares the story of one of his most dramatic and impressive cases.

In the News

Short true crime stories.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Phoney Talent Scouts!

A gang of con men posing as talent scouts use the promise of fame to swindle money from the proud parents of talented children.

issue_title: Murder Suspect to Face Lie Detector Test
description:
The Execution of Caesar Larsen!

A powerful and extremely egotistical mob boss is given a death sentence due to heart problems. Given one year to live, he constructs a plan to live forever.

The False Rumor Factory!

A confidence man begins running a slanderous rumour mill for profit.

Missing Persons Cop

A cop who investigates missing persons describes his typical work, and shares several cases.

The Tell-Tale Frost!

A jealous fur trader commits what he believes to be the perfect murder.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Oldest

A biography of the elderly chief of police in Franklin, Nebraska, E.W. Agnew

Where is Marvyn Moon?

A man who testifies for the DA against a criminal goes on the run in fear for his life, and finds himself hunted by both sides of the law.

issue_title: The Innocent Man in Murderers' Row!
description:
The Innocent Man in Murderers' Row!

A man who works for a gang of extortionists is tried and convicted for the murder of a victim of the gang. Despite his protestations of innocence, he is sentenced to death. The extortionists seize this seemingly perfect opportunity to bring the DA to heel.

SS Ace

A biography of Fred Tate, a secret service agent.

The Alibi King!

A criminal begins a racket providing seemingly unbreakable alibis to fellow criminals in order to escape prosecution.

Bridge Cop

A police officer responsible for guarding bridges reports on his work and on some thrilling cases.

Ideal Cop

Short biography of Stanley Elkins, a popular police officer.

The Clue of the Housekeeper's Cold!

A man whose stock market dealings have led him to the edge of bankruptcy comes up with a plan to dig himself out of debt-- insurance fraud.

The Crime File

A text story.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

Murder at Ceiling Zero!

A gem theft syndicate comes under investigation following a seemingly unrelated murder.

Prison Train!

International criminals being transported for deportation via train undertake a daring escape. In hiding and growing increasingly paranoid, each attempts to flee.

Miser's Millions!

A secretly wealthy miser is robbed by a masked figure who takes him for everything he has. Soon it becomes a pattern, and misers across the city find themselves under attack.

The Detective with High Heels

A female private detective becomes embroiled in the case of a man whose debts have landed his young niece in hot water.

Night Rider!

A biography of Roy Farrar, who once helped to foil a robbery.

The Frozen Clue

A spurned contractor takes his revenge on a politician, committing what he believes to be the perfect murder.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Man Who Fooled Juries!

A corrupt lawyer uses his charisma and crafty tricks to get even the guiltiest of clients out of trouble.

The Wire Tap Crimes!

A series of armoured car robberies are carried out using what could only be inside information. Soon, the DA uncovers a gang of wiretappers who use their sophisticated system to steal with impunity and dodge the cops.

The Prisoner in the Muslin Mask!

A gang of protection racketeers are headed by a mysterious man whom none of them have ever actually met. When a witness threatens that anonymity, the leader steps out of the shadows to silence him.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

The Cop with the Deadshot Pencil!

A police artist describes the important work done by the members of his department, and describes a particular case that was solved by police artists.

The Case of the Painter's Peril!

An art forger and con man kills the artist he's been ripping off when the artist threatens to go to the police. Staging it as an accident, he believes he has committed the perfect murder.

The Crime File

A text story.

Like Mom!

A short biography of Mary Sullivan, a police officer, and her daughter, the head of a private detective agency.

The Crime Warden!

A convicted criminal escapes jail and seeks revenge on the judge, jury, and district attorney who imprisoned him by trapping him in his own private prison.

The Bachelor of Crime!

A gang of college graduates take up a life of crime, planning and executing clever heists using their areas of expertise.

The Case of the Double Killing!

A murderer kills a wealthy man and escapes, seemingly without leaving a clue behind. His plot seems perfect, until another killer enters the game.

Manhunt

A short biography of two boys who helped to locate an escaped convict.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

Boss of the Big House

A prison guard with revolutionary ideas of prison reform rises through the ranks, earning the grudging respect of the prisoners he is charged with watching. This man, Lewis Lawes, was responsible for modernizing Sing Sing.

The Case of the 45 Degree Tightrope!

A jealous man believes he has committed the perfect murder when he rigs the tightrope of his romantic rival, causing him to die spectacularly in the middle of a stunt.

Scientific Sherlock

A short biography of Edward Oscar Heinrich, a forensic scientist.

Helicopter Ace

A short biography of Capt. Gus Crawford, who flies helicopters for the police.

The Crime File

A text story.

The State vs Harrington!

A gang of counterfeiters are arrested, and claim that the DA's aide, Harrington, has been accepting their bribes. Despite his protestations of innocence, the DA is forced to arrest and try his friend.

Cartooning Cop

A short biography of William Voges, a police officer who draws cartoons to teach road safety to children

The Case of the Twelve O'Clock Killer!

A murderer who strikes at precisely midnight terrorizes the city. A popular newsman warns the people before every murder, but the police struggle to capture the killer.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

The DA's Stand-In!

After the DA is shot in a sting operation, Harrington is forced to work for a temporary DA. Despite his glowing record, the man's more timid methods fail to convince Harrington.

Scotland Yard

A nonfiction account of the workings of Scotland Yard.

The Case of the Gold-Cross Minks!

A jealous mink farmer murders a rival over a special mink crossbreed that could be worth a fortune.

Guardians of the Law

Reprinted from Real Fact Comics #4. A story extolling the virtues of law enforcement in all its incarnations.

The Crime File

A text story.

No Foolin'

Short law enforcement stories.

The Phantom Thief!

A gang of stealthy criminals manage to steal items and bypass alarm systems that nobody should have even known about.

The Four Kings of Crime!

A gang of four criminals run their criminal empires in four adjoining counties, each naming himself the king of his respective territory. When one of the kings turns on his compatriots, he finds his life under threat.

A Medal for Pop Grogan!

A retired police officer turned campus lawman spins tall tales about his time in the service. Soon he finds himself pulled into a case almost as dramatic as his imagined adventures.

You Can't Beat the Law!

Reprinted from Gang Busters #8. A short story about a police officer and his criminal son.

Rogues' Gallery

Describing the importance of mugshots and the way that police files about criminals help to solve crimes.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

Weekend Clown

A biography of Art Savage, a police officer who acts as a rodeo clown on the weekend.

The Crime File

A text story.

Bodyguard

A biography of James J. Rowley, a U.S. Secret Service agent who was tasked with guarding the lives of Presidents Roosevelt and Truman.

The Son of Killer Calhoun!

A murderer is sentenced to death, but dies while trying to flee custody. His young son, not understanding the cause of his father's death, swears to get revenge on the DA.

issue_title: How Gangland's Sinister Disc Jockey Was Trapped!
description:
The Richest Man in Prison!

A man embezzles money from his employer and buries it, tattooing the map to his haul on the bottom of his foot, convinced that he has committed the perfect crim.

The Case of the Crooked Models!

A down-on-her-luck model is convinced to take part in a theft ring.

Camera Cop

A police photographer reveals the ways that his skills served justice during peacetime and at war.

Old Timer

A fact feature.

The Case of the Blind Crook!

Mr. District Attorney pursues a criminal by disguising himself and insinuating himself into the man's gang.

A Worthless Fortune

A text story.

Hard to Kill!

A fact feature.

The Case of the Honest Burglar

A man, being blackmailed for his past, kills his blackmailer and attempts to frame it as self-defence.

Station K-I-L-L!

A disc jockey uses his radio show to relay messages to his criminal compatriots, the Polka Dot Gang.

You Catch a Killer!

A vicious murderer is put to death with the help of average citizens, who do their best to help the police locate the man when he escapes custody.

Citizen Nye Dies Twice!

A gang begins kidnapping seemingly random men off of the street. The pattern goes unnoticed until Harrington also becomes a victim of the gang.

I Battled the Timber Pirates

A gang of criminals set up a timber theft empire, ravaging the government forests of the northwest until they are stumbled upon by a forestry ranger.

Fingerprint Facts

A description of the history of the use of fingerprints.

The Case of the Crooked Mate!

A ship's first mate smuggles people onboard his ship, and when his crime is discovered he murders his captain, committing what he believes to be the perfect murder.

The Crime File

A text story.

Eyewitness!

An unremarkable man suddenly finds himself the eyewitness to a murder while taking part in a scavenger hunt. Terrified he refuses to come forward, but a picture taken at the scene of the crime soon identifies him, and puts him in mortal danger.

I Was a Killer's Bodyguard!

A powerful mob boss is paralyzed by fear at the idea that he might be murdered by rivals. He hires a bodyguard who, unbeknownst to him, is the undercover DA.

Beware the Rackets

An example of a way in which criminals may try to pass fake bills to innocent people.

The DA Pounds a Beat!

A gang of mobsters who shoot to kill in their confrontations with the cops are causing a precipitous drop in police enrolment. To show his belief in the work of frontline officers, the DA takes over the beat of a wounded patrolman, putting him right in the gang's crosshairs.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

The Man Whose Eyes Started Fires!

A fire safety engineer becomes trained in the art of investigating fires. He soon becomes involved in the investigation of a series of mysterious fires at a factory.

The Case of the Permanently Kayoed Champ

A boxing champ is poisoned by his coach in order to make him lose big matches. When the boxer discovers this duplicity, his coach murders him.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Impossible Crime!

During a bank's move to a new location, the transfer of its 136 million dollars becomes the target of a gang of criminals.

The Marksman of Crime!

A former SS manhunter is hired by a gang of criminals to kill the DA before he can uncover the gang's activities.

The Revenge of Johnny Raadik!

A pair of GIs who fought together during the war open a garage together after they return home. When one of them is gunned down by a criminal who is attempting to muscle in on their business, the surviving partner swears revenge.

Crime Oddities

Short explanation of the origins of the names and punishments of various crimes.

I Drive a Paddy Wagon!

A police officer responsible for driving paddy wagons shares the details of his work, and relates some of the dramatic occurrences he has been witness to.

The Case of the Stolen Cathode Ray!

A jealous research assistant murders the professor who he believes has been stealing credit for all the work their lab is producing. Staging the scene to appear like a robbery, the assistant believes he has outsmarted the cops and committed the perfect murder.

Crime and Punishment!

A description of various methods of execution used through the ages.

The Crime File

A text story.

Blueprint of a Traitor!

The DA is recruited by a secret FBI task force investigating whether tank designs are being leaked to America's enemies. Attempting to steal secrets to test security and entrap real spies, he soon finds himself accused of treason.

Diary of a Criminal!

A newly-released prisoner turns on his criminal compatriots and begins publishing his diary in the newspaper. Refusing to cooperate with the DA, he is soon gunned down by his enemies, seemingly taking his most important secrets to the grave.

Counterfeit Oddities!

A brief history of counterfeiting.

The Big Basketball Fix!

A racketeering gang attempts to fix a college basketball game in order to pay off a debt. When the star player refuses to play ball, the criminals threaten and coerce him into throwing the game.

I Trap Art Racketeers

An art specialist and detective describes the important work he does uncovering forgeries. He shares several thrilling tales from his job, including the story of an old artist whose work is used in fraud against his will.

The Case of the Midget Auto Classic!

A group of gamblers sabotage an auto race by killing the favoured driver after the man refuses to take a bribe. Faking a car accident, they believe they have pulled off the perfect crime.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Magic Money Machine

A short story warning about potential fraudsters.

The Gang with 1,000 Gimmicks!

A gang of criminals pull off a series of heists using gimmickry that foil the police at every turn.

Crime Curios!

Interesting factoids about crime and punishment in the past.

issue_title: The Killer in the Iron Mask!
description:
The Killer in the Iron Mask!

When a criminal upsets his compatriots the ultimate punishment is issued: a metal mask affixed permanently to his head. One man, apparently driven mad by this punishment, exiled by the underworld and hunted by the police, begins a one-man crime wave.

Witness for Sale!

A man runs a red light, killing a pedestrian. He is soon approached by a man offering witnesses who will swear that the light was green-- for a price.

Unusual Laws!

Short stories of the laws of the past.

The Case of the Circus Queen Crime

A jealous circus performer murders his rival and frames her elephant for the deed, believing he has committed the perfect crime.

The Crime File

A text story.

Occupation, Killer!

A hired killer carries out a series of assassinations that leave the police stumped. Attempting to entrap him, the DA puts out a hit on himself.

I Hired My Killer!

The owner of a print shop finds himself caught up in criminal activity when he rents out the upper floor of his factory to a mysterious man. Horrified by his unintentional involvement, and convinced that he will be brought to trial for another man's crime, he hires a hitman to end his life.

Quick Quiz

Short interesting factoids.

The Case of the Honest Ex-Convicts!

Several ex-convicts struggle to get regular employment, and find themselves pushed to the brink. With the help of the DA, hundreds find honest jobs, however, one seems determined to continue committing crimes.

The Case of the Blinded Partner

A greedy miner murders his partner over a vein of gold, and stages the incident to appear as an accident caused by the man's progressive blindness.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Case of the Plundered Pearls!

A bizarre crime wave strikes the city, the mysterious criminal stealing only pearls, to the exclusion of even more valuable jewelry.

Crime Curios!

Short factoids about the history of crime and punishment.

issue_title: The Case of the Wanted Criminals
description:
The Case of the Wanted Criminals!

Dozens of wanted criminals inexplicably begin arriving in the city, and all seem to vanish to the same place. The DA pulls out all the stops to track the criminals and uncover their plot.

The Crime of the Century!

A series of mysterious murders all leave behind clues that seem to point a little too directly to the museum and its reclusive curator.

Tracking the Criminal!

Detailing the use of unusual methods for identifying criminals.

Beware the Rackets!

A short story warning about potential fraudsters.

The Case of the Small-Time Hoofer

A Broadway-bound dancer with a hot temper is poised to lose everything after assaulting a club patron. To avoid having his lost temper reported to his Broadway employer, he kills his previous employer in what he believes to be the perfect murder.

Conscientious Cop

Short biography of Leroy Kaschub, a police officer who didn't give breaks to family or friends.

Amazing Ray!

An explanation of the use of infrared rays in the combatting of various crimes.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Prisoner in Cell 13

A man condemned for murder calls for the DA on the day he is scheduled to be executed, and makes a stunning revelation.

Law Oddities!

Interesting legal factoids from the past.

issue_title: The Case of the Secret Six
description:
The Case of the Secret Six!

A group of prominent citizens take the law into their own hands, forming a vigilante committee in order to deal with criminals who have escaped the law on a technicality. Though they are popular with the public, the DA becomes worried about the precedent they are setting, and about the lengths to which they might go to rid the city of crime.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

The Driving School for Death!

A dangerously unethical and unsafe driving school churns out drivers who do not know how to obey the rules of the road or who are not fit to drive, resulting in dozens of deadly accidents. The DA sends in Miss Miller to investigate, and when she vanishes along with the car the stakes are raised precipitously.

Crime Punishment!

Short factoids about crime and punishment in the past.

Special Prosecutor!

A special prosecutor is appointed by the governor to deal with a series of devastating arsons that have baffled the police.

Beware the Rackets

A short story warning about potential frauds.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Crimes of Caesar Torrow!

A gangster who was highly active in the 1920s is finally released from prison. Believing that he will be welcomed back with open arms by the gang that he hasn't run in over twenty years, he finds that they have turned on him. Soon, a series of murders committed in a fashion not seen since the 20s begin tearing through the underworld.

Beware the Bogus Beggars!

A gang of criminals pretend to be beggars, forcing legitimate impoverished people off the streets and into petty crime. Soon their crime wave escalates to murder.

The Hot-Rod Racket!

A craze for driving recklessly sweeps the teenage community. A well-publicized campaign to get the hotrods off the road brings them to the attention of a gang of criminals, who begin to use the cars to effect perfect getaways.

The Case of the Poisoned Candle!

A greedy butler murders his ailing employer before the man can discover his employee's theft.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Sound Waves of Crime!

When a bank robber apparently commits suicide, the DA discovers a mysterious smashed record on his body that seems to have recorded only a series of indecipherable clicks. Soon a crime wave strikes the city, the only clue another smashed record found on yet another corpse.

Beware the Rackets

Explaining the details of some basic scams that con artists may run on you in your own home.

The Crimes of Mr. Jumbo!

A series of seemingly impossible crimes shake the city. A gang of highly organized criminals seem able to operate with impunity using a method that the DA cannot even imagine.

Department Store Sleuth

A police officer working part-time security in a large department store reminisces about past instances of shoplifting and crime before going on duty and uncovering new crimes.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

Freak Laws!

Short vignettes about unusual laws around the United States.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Case of the Outlaw Broadcasters!

A gang of criminals utilize radio jamming technology to enable them to commit crimes without police intervention.

Clairvoyance at Scotland Yard!

A brief biography of Nell St. John Montague, a famous clairvoyant who worked for Scotland Yard.

Police Science!

Relaying the recent advancements in the use of vacuum tubes for police surveillance, and of hidden cameras placed in watches.

The Honest Convicts!

Released convicts who are determined to go on the straight and narrow find themselves blackmailed and forced to work for a criminal enterprise, or killed if they refuse to play ball.

The Case of the Fat Crook!

A master criminal orchestrates an escape from prison, believing that by losing a great deal of weight and burning off his own fingerprints he will be untraceable.

The Crime File

A text story.

Death at the Wheel

An ungrateful army buddy kills a man in order to steal his money, attempting to play it off as a failure of the man's brakes.

State Trooper

A state trooper relates his typical cases, and tells the story of a highway robbery that he foiled.

Story-Book Sleuth

The story of Bill Quaine, a hero cop who was known for busting gangsters in Harlem.

In This Corner - Death!

A boxer is approached by a gang of criminals to throw his matches, but he refuses and seeks the assistance of the D.A.

issue_title: The Man of a Thousand Faces!
description:
The Man of a Thousand Faces!

A gang of criminals kidnap a master of disguise, intending to force him to impersonate the DA in order to stage phoney raids on gambling dens and confiscate all their money. Unwittingly, they kidnap the DA himself.

The Case of the Modern Raffles!

A series of hotel thefts in a swank part of town baffles the police, as the only man identified by the victims seems to have been nowhere near the loot.

The Case of the Chattering Wife

An impoverished gambler plots to murder his bookie Hiring a couple of actors to impersonate himself and his wife in order to establish a foolproof alibi, he believes that he has committed the perfect murder.

The Crime File

A text story.

About a Uniform!

Short factual story about the creation of the first NYPD officer uniform.

Racket in Diamonds

A gang of criminals sets up a racket stealing and reselling industrial diamond tools, taking advantage of the recent shortage.

The Hot Money Gang!

The DA's office develops a system to identify even small money denominations that have been stolen from banks. However, a gang of secretive money launderers seem to have developed a foolproof plot to foil the DA's efforts.

Three Clues to a Killer!

An eyewitness who had testified for the DA is murdered in the street by a hired killer. Publishing the details of the crime in a widely-read police magazine, the DA soon finds himself receiving tips from all over the world.

The Case of the Antique Dish!

A greedy antique store clerk murders his boss in order to get all of the remuneration for a valuable item himself. Staging an elaborate alibi he believes he has committed the perfect murder.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Phantom of the Highways

A mysterious and apparently skeletal driver runs dangerous drivers off the road, seeking to give them fitting punishment for their crimes. Unable to track the man, the DA sets up a sting to trap him.

The Case of the Bad Luck Clues!

A popular civic leader is assassinated while giving an anti-crime speech. Though the DA pursues the case aggressively, his investigation is beset by a series of seemingly endless accidents that destroy important clues.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short

The T.V. Gang

A gang of audacious criminals stage a series of home invasions while the victims are home, counting on the victims being too absorbed in their televisions to pay attention to the rest of the house.

Reprieve from Death!

A man is spared from hanging due to a faulty gallows.

The Killer's Accomplice

A man escapes from prison, and dodges captivity a second time by bribing a bystander, who reports that the man escaped custody with the help of an accomplice.

The Crime File

A text story.

Shoot-- Like a Camera

A crime syndicate carries out a series of daring heists with the assistance of a cameraman who uses various methods film and still photography to stage the perfect crimes.

A Crime is Born

A trio of dissatisfied blue collar workers hatch a plan to become criminals following a near-death experience. Using their jobs, they are able to pull off seemingly impossible heists.

Quick Quiz

Short true facts.

Message from the Beat!

Detailing the use of technology in police patrols and communications.

Bomb Squad

A series of bomb blasts rock the city as a daring criminal uses his explosive knowledge to pull off a series of crimes. Under investigation by the DA, the criminal plants a bomb at the police station in order to destroy all the files.

Casey the Cop

A comedy short.

The Case of the Night-Shift Scandal

A pair of petty criminals are discovered to be thieves by a coworker. One of them sneaks out in the middle of his shift to murder the coworker, and the pair believe they have established the perfect alibi.

The Crime File

A text story.

Strange Laws!

Short true factoids about strange laws around the United States.

Operation Annie K

A gang of jewel smugglers operating in the ports are busted by the DA, but manage to get the drop on him and take him hostage.

The Merchant of Death!

Mr District Attorney becomes involved in the investigation of a gang of criminals who have begun running illegal weapons and using them in the commission of other crimes.

The False Code of Honor!

A young boy who was involved in the robbery of a freight train and the wounding of a railroad security officer refuses to rat out his friends, though Mr District Attorney has sincere doubts as to his guilt.

Border Cop

An agent of the US Border Patrol describes his daily work, and reveals the story of his most dramatic case.

Firebug Catcher

Detailing the life of Thomas Brophy, a fire marshal for New York City.

Death Writes a Forgery!

A con man and an expert forger team up to rob the recently bereaved by forging the writing of the recently deceased and calling in fraudulent IOUs.

The Grapevine

A text story.

Crime Rides the Sky!

A plane designer seeks revenge on the man who stole his designs, and stages it to look like a suicide.

The Case of the Loan Shark!

A man whose wife is ill is forced to turn to a loanshark to pay for her care, but soon finds himself deeply in debt to the shark. He, and other victims, find their lives falling apart under the loanshark's aggressive tactics.

The Booby-Trap Killer!

An extortionist is sent to prison on the word of four men, and vows revenge. Shortly after his release, the men begin to receive booby-trapped packages, with fatal outcomes.

The Gas-Man Sleuth!

A young man who once dreamed to be a policeman is forced to become a gas metre reader, but is still able to help further the cause of justice.

Harlem's Protector

Documenting the exploits of hero cop John Roberts.

Subway Cop

A transit policeman describes his daily activity, and shares the story of one of his most thrilling cases.

The Murder with a Million Witnesses!

A jealous actor, outraged at having been replaced by another actor, murders his rival live on air by loading a prop gun with a real bullet.

Fingerprint Facts

A text story.

I Guard the Convict Trains!

A prison guard responsible for guarding prisoners being transported upriver via train retires. He is approached by his replacement, and tells the story of a daring escape attempt.

The Counterfeit Medicine Mob!

A gang of criminals comes up with a new scheme, to counterfeit medicine and sell it to pharmacies regardless of the consequences.

issue_title: The Thrilling Manhunt That Led to Scotland Yard!
description:
The DA Meets Scotland Yard!

A criminal goes on a crime spree across the world, culminating in his daring robbery of the Bank of England.

I Sell Money

A pawnbroker explains his work, and what happens when somebody brings in stolen items to his shop.

The Case of the Man Who Died Twice

A man uncovers that a man has faked his own death as part of an insurance fraud scheme. Seeing an opportunity, he murders the man in exchange for a portion of the money from the man's widow.

Case M-31-- the Story of Albert X!

A cab driver relates the story of the time he was held up by a criminal for protection money.

Oddities in Crime

Several true crime snippets.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Big Frame

Mr District Attorney relates a story from his past. Then the Assistant District Attorney, he was framed for taking bribes from criminals.

The People vs Killer Kale!

Mr District Attorney brings a notorious jewel thief and smuggler to trial, calling several witnesses to demonstrate how a case is made.

The Case of the Vanishing Crook!

A crime wave is perpetrated by the famous magician Escapo, who uses his travelling show to cover for his criminal enterprises.

Concerto in Murder

A humiliated violinist murders his harshest critic and romantic rival. Constructing an intricate alibi, he believes he has gotten away with murder.

Emergency Cop

A police officer who responds to dangerous emergency situations describes his work, and tells the tale of one of his most dramatic cases.

Oddities in Crime

Relating brief true crime stories.

The Crime File

A text story.

The Street of Forgotten Men!

An apparent good samaritan preys on the homeless and dispossessed in the city in order to enrich himself.

issue_title: The Rise and Fall of 'Lucky' Lynn!
description:
The Rise and Fall of 'Lucky' Lynn!

A career criminal proves himself to be incredibly lucky, quickly rising to power in the underworld, bringing him to the attention of Mr District Attorney.

The Old Master

A biography of detective William J Burns.

The Case of the Money Makers!

description:
The Case of the Careless Caretaker

Mister Hammond has rather foolishly invested every last penny he has in a series of fish tanks. His hope is that a local aquarium will purchase the tanks from him. The superintendent, Finley, though, refuses Hammond. Faced with financial ruin, Hammond lingers as Finley feeds the piranha, for a crowd of onlookers. When Finley spies a knife at the bottom of the piranha tank, he immediately fires the caretaker, Brady. Hammond sees Brady's public firing as an opportunity. Fishing the knife out of the piranha tank, Hammond uses it to stab Finley to death.

Hammond then contacts the police to report the murder. Hammond pins the crime on the caretaker. Detective Arvin Steinmetz, though, immediately sees the hole in Hammond's story. Hammond claims he saw Brady reach into the piranha tank and grab the knife to kill Finley. Steinmetz points out that Brady, in his role as caretaker, would have known better than to stick his bare arm into a piranha tank. Catching Hammond in an obvious lie, Steinmetz accuses Hammond of being the killer. Hammond confesses his guilt, and is tried and sentenced for the crime.
